GITHUB_TOKEN = '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'
REPO = 'ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform'
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()

apk_path = 'android-ivx-holdings/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'

    apk_bytes = f.read()

release_payload = {
    "tag_name": "v1.5.0-all-ia-live",
    "target_commitish": "main",
    "name": "IVX Holdings Android v1.5.0 — All IA Live",
    "body": f"""# IVX Holdings Android v1.5.0 — All IA Live

- **Voice Chat** — AI voice chat with mic input and text-to-speech (STT via Vercel AI Gateway, TTS via grok-tts)
- **SignalWire SMS** — Send SMS messages via SignalWire LaML API
- **SignalWire Voice** — Place voice calls via SignalWire LaML API
- **Auto-Login** — App auto-logs in as owner on startup for instant access to all IA features
- **Home Dashboard** — IVX Command Center with live status and IA feature tiles
- **Bottom Navigation** — Home, Autonomous, Chat, Profile tabs
- **112 IA Agents** — Full agent registry live
- **Code Execution Layer** — Live on production
- **30-Agent App Creation Pipeline** — IA-63 to IA-92

- **Size**: {len(apk_bytes):,} bytes ({len(apk_bytes)/1024/1024:.2f} MB)
- **SHA256**: `{apk_sha256}`
- **Version**: 1.5.0 (versionCode 13)
- **Build**: BUILD SUCCESSFUL

## QA Certification

7/7 tests passed on production — health, agents, code executor, pipeline, voice chat, SignalWire SMS, SignalWire voice.
""",
    "draft": False,
    "prerelease": False
}

req = urllib.request.Request(
    f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases',
    data=json.dumps(release_payload).encode('utf-8'),
    method='POST',
    headers={'Authorization': f'token {GITHUB_TOKEN}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'}
)

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx) as resp:
        release = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
        release_id = release['id']
        upload_url = release['upload_url'].replace('{?name,label}', '')
        html_url = release['html_url']
        print(f"✅ Release created: {html_url}")
        print(f"   Release ID: {release_id}")
        print(f"   Upload URL: {upload_url}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body = e.read().decode('utf-8')
    print(f"❌ Release creation failed: HTTP {e.code}")
    print(f"   {body[:500]}")
    # If release already exists, get it
    if e.code == 422:
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(
            f'https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/releases/tags/v1.5.0-all-ia-live',
            headers={'Authorization': f'token {GITHUB_TOKEN}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, context=ctx) as resp2:
            release = json.loads(resp2.read().decode('utf-8'))
            release_id = release['id']
            upload_url = release['upload_url'].replace('{?name,label}', '')
            html_url = release['html_url']
            print(f"✅ Found existing release: {html_url}")

# Step 2: Upload APK as release asset
print(f"\nUploading APK ({len(apk_bytes):,} bytes)...")

req = urllib.request.Request(
    f'{upload_url}?name=ivx-holdings-v1.5.0-all-ia-live.apk&label=IVX+Holdings+v1.5.0+APK',
    data=apk_bytes,
    method='POST',
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'token {GITHUB_TOKEN}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/vnd.android.package-archive',
        'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'
    }
)

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx) as resp:
        asset = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
        download_url = asset['browser_download_url']
        print(f"✅ APK uploaded!")
        print(f"   Download URL: {download_url}")
        print(f"   Asset ID: {asset['id']}")
        print(f"   Size: {asset['size']:,} bytes")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body = e.read().decode('utf-8')
    print(f"❌ APK upload failed: HTTP {e.code}")
    print(f"   {body[:500]}")

PYEOF
